outputs.explanation: Spatial deconvolution heatmaps overlaid on tissue micrographs, not a summary plot of averages requiring individual data points.
Box plots are shown with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each group/condition.
GSEA enrichment score line plots; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.

Bar chart shows log2 fold-change values derived from differential expression analysis (a single computed statistic per gene comparing group distributions, with associated p-values), not a mean of individually measured replicate values that would require overlaid data points.
H&E and IHC micrographs, not a quantitative summary plot.
